summary.zh: 规划 GA4 与 GTM 事件，排查埋点失效
summary.en: Plan GA4 and Tag Manager events, debug tracking

description.zh: 为 GA4、Google Tag Manager 和转化追踪设计事件分类与埋点方案，也能排查事件丢失或重复上报的问题。适合新站点搭建追踪、改版后数据异常或需要统一指标口径时使用。
description.en: Designs GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking plans with a clear event taxonomy, and debugs missing or duplicated events. Use it when setting up tracking, after a redesign or when metrics disagree.
